HOW TO REVIEW

Keep the detail.
Bring its address.

These are functioning pages, with your interactive room in each—not image mockups. Labels are a review layer you can hide.

  1. 01

    Open a study.

    Explore the whole page. Try the menu, repair stories, disclosure rows and palette controls.

  2. 02

    Use the section map.

    Search for a detail, jump to it, or click Copy ID. Every entry explains the design idea.

  3. 03

    Pick across all three.

    For example: “Delta navigation, Roveia case stack, Atmos palette panels.” Use the IDs for precision.
